pages.text: The plates resemble dry bark until they move. One opens, then another; a narrow amber lining appears between them. The surrounding pale skin continues over materials that were never wood.
pages.title: Folded bark
The shutters
pages.text: These notes use the name Shutter Bloom. The name describes its shape. It does not explain what is doing the growing.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: The surface growth spreads from a nearby bloom. Removing that source stops its colony and leaves supported tissue dormant. Break the tissue itself for flakes; tearing away its support leaves no useful harvest.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: Living tissue and infected creatures transmit infection through contact. Standing nearby is not enough. Leave yourself a clear place to step before cutting a sample.
